context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure package's add-to-cart mutation hook, including proper import of the hook, passing variantId and quantity as variables, handling of the CommerceError thrown on invalid quantities, and the default quantity of 1 when not specified.

checklist.name: Import useAddItem
checklist.description: The solution imports `useAddItem` from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` (or from the cart sub-path) and calls it as a hook, not reimplementing the mutation manually.

checklist.name: Pass variantId + quantity
checklist.description: The hook's returned function is called with an object containing `variantId` (string/ID) and `quantity` (number), matching the AddItemHook's actionInput shape.

checklist.name: CommerceError on bad quantity
checklist.description: The solution correctly handles or demonstrates that a `CommerceError` (not a plain Error) is thrown when quantity is not a positive integer.

checklist.name: Default quantity = 1
checklist.description: When quantity is omitted or undefined, the mutation defaults to quantity 1, as per the hook's fetcher implementation.
